blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.
blocks.zh: 可靠的机器人自主性要求从局部和吵闹的观察中推理世界. 然而,许多感知系统模型仅可被可见的场景区域,依赖于固定的语义分类,并承担可靠的传感器测量. 这些假设在被隔离,小物体相遇,以及感官退化等下被打破. 在本文中,我提出了对不完全认识-场景理解的研究愿景. 我将这个愿景围绕三个基本挑战来组织:不完整的证据,不完整的知识,和不完整的传感器可靠性. 我通过模式感知,语义占用预测,开放世界的场景理解,标签高效的学习,以及不确定性导向的多模式融合,来讨论我对应对这些挑战的研究贡献. 基于这些贡献,我概述了未来以信仰为中心的4D场景展示的研究方向。 这些表述旨在联合地模拟几何,语义,运动,和不确定性. 我还讨论了主动感知和安全的适应策略,这些策略允许机器人通过相互作用来减少不确定性. 目标是发展可调节和可操作的场景表现,支持在动态和开放的世界环境中的可靠自主.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robots do not perceive the world directly but they infer it from partial, noisy measurements [ 47 ] . Reliable robot autonomy requires converting these measurements into a scene belief that is (i) complete enough to support safe action and (ii) calibrated enough to expose when it may be wrong [ 13 , 21 ] . Yet much of today’s perception reliability is achieved by engineering away uncertainty: operating in bounded environments, with fixed ontologies, and with clean, well-calibrated sensors [ 45 , 23 ] . In everyday operation, three forms of incompleteness break these assumptions: incomplete evidence from occlusion and unobserved future states, incomplete knowledge in open worlds (novel objects and limited labels) [ 1 ] , and incomplete reliability when sensors degrade or disagree [ 10 ] . Under these conditions, models often produce not only errors but overconfident hypotheses [ 13 , 40 ] that propagate into brittle downstream behavior, leading to planning failures under perceptual uncertainty [ 20 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 机器人没有直接感知世界,但他们从局部的,吵闹的测量中推断出来[47]. 可靠的机器人自主性要求将这些测量转换成场景信念,即(一) 足够完整,足以支持安全行动,(二) 足够校准,在可能错误时暴露出来[13,21]. 然而,今天许多感知可靠性是通过工程消除不确定性来实现的:在有界限的环境中运行,有固定的本体学,有干净的、精准的传感器[45、23]。 在日常操作中,三种形式的不完全打破了这些假设:来自隐蔽状态和不观察的未来状态的不完全证据,开放世界中的不完全知识(小物体和有限标签)[1],以及传感器降解或不同意时的不完全可靠性[10]. 在这些条件下,模型往往不仅产生错误,而且产生过度自信的假说[13,40],传播到粗糙的下游行为中,导致在概念不确定性下规划失败[20,6].

blocks.en: My research program, Perception Beyond the Visible, asks: how can robots build scene representations over semantics, geometry, and motion that remain calibrated under incompleteness and actionable for planning and interaction. I pursue this through a tight loop of (1) tasks and benchmarks [ 11 , 37 , 43 , 26 , 36 , 35 , 33 ] that make incompleteness measurable, and (2) learning methods that explicitly model occlusion structure [ 37 , 38 , 43 , 29 ] forecast future states [ 30 ] , separate known from unknown [ 36 , 35 ] , learn from limited labels [ 15 , 17 , 31 ] , and estimate modality reliability for selective fusion [ 33 , 32 ] . Across 2D and 3D, these contributions shift perception from what is seen to what is present , widening the operational envelope in cluttered, dynamic settings.
blocks.zh: 我的研究计划“视觉超越可见者”问道:机器人如何在语义、几何学和运动上建立场景表现,这些表现仍然在不完全的状态下进行校准,并可用于规划和互动。 我通过(1) 任务和基准[11、37、43、26、36、35、33]的紧密循环来追求这一点,这些任务和基准使不完全性可以衡量,以及(2) 明确模拟隔离结构的学习方法[37、38、43、29] 预测未来状态[30],与未知的[36、35]分开,从有限的标签[15、17、31]中学习,并估计选择性聚变的可靠性[33、32]。 在2D和3D之间,这些贡献从所见所闻转变为现时,在复杂、动态的环境中扩大了业务包。

blocks.en: II Current Research
blocks.zh: 二. 目前的研究

blocks.en: Foundational Contributions. To facilitate robust autonomy, I establish methodological foundations that make progress measurable and support rapid development. First, we developed a large-scale multimodal benchmark and instance-centric metrics for LiDAR panoptic tracking [ 11 ] . With over 13 × 13\times more instances than SemanticKITTI, its scale and urban diversity expose failure modes in dense, dynamic scenes and underpin my subsequent work [ 15 , 35 , 33 ] . Second, complementing classification-centric NAS surveys [ 9 ] , we systematized NAS for dense prediction [ 34 ] , distilling pixel-level constraints and architectural insights I leverage to design efficient networks across my core research [ 30 , 33 ] . Together, these contributions enable my overarching vision.
blocks.zh: 基础捐款。 为了促进强有力的自主,我建立了方法基础,使进展可以衡量,并支持快速发展。 首先,我们为LiDAR泛光学跟踪开发了大规模多式联运基准和以实例为中心的指标[11]。 其规模和城市多样性在密集、动态的场景中暴露出失败模式, 第二,补充以分类为中心的NAS调查[9],我们把NAS系统化用于密集预测[34],提炼像素水平的制约和建筑洞察力. 我利用设计高效的网络 跨越我的核心研究 [30,33]. 这些贡献合在一起,使我有了总的远见。

blocks.zh: 费格。 1:不完全感知感知的图解:(A)隐蔽,(B)未知,(C)感知失败.

blocks.en: II-A Incomplete Evidence: Perceiving the Invisible
blocks.zh: II-A 不完整 证据:感知无形者

blocks.en:
Amodal Perception. Most robotic perception remains visible-only (modal) [ 22 , 8 ] ,
treating occlusion as missing evidence rather than an inferable scene state [ 16 , 48 ] .
I formalize amodal perception so robots can represent what is present, not just what is seen, supporting object permanence for interaction [ 42 ] .
I introduced amodal panoptic segmentation (APS) and benchmark [ 37 ] , unifying background semantics with instance masks that include occluded regions (cf. Fig. 1 (A)) and extending earlier amodal instance/semantic formulations [ 24 , 54 ] for a holistic scene interpretation.
My initial APS approach explicitly predicts visible/occluding/occluded regions to capture occluder-occludee structure [ 37 ] .
To address severe occlusion, I proposed a proposal-free layered formulation that predicts non-overlapping masks ordered by occlusion, together with an explicit-memory refiner that completes occluded regions via experience-based shape embeddings [ 38 ] .
This improves occluded-object segmentation by ∼ \sim 5 pp and transfers to amodal instance segmentation with comparable gains.
Since annotating invisible regions is subjective and costly, we curated AmodalSynthDrive [ 43 ] , a large synthetic dataset with amodal ground truth, and introduced amodal depth estimation to infer occluded geometry.
We further extended amodal reasoning to dynamics with amodal optical flow [ 29 ] , predicting motion through occlusions rather than failing at occlusion boundaries. These resources have since been adopted for occlusion-aware adaptation and amodal depth pretraining [ 2 , 3 , 25 ] .
Coupling APS with amodal flow improves panoptic tracking and reduces ID switches during crossings.
blocks.zh:
模式感应. 大多数机器人感知仍然只有可见(模式)[22,8],
将隔离视为缺失证据,而不是不可推断的场景状态[16,48].
我将一种模式感知正规化,这样机器人就可以代表现在的事物,而不仅仅是所看到的事物,支持物体的永久性相互作用[42].
我引入了一种模式泛光学分解(APS)和基准[37],将背景语义与包括斜面区域(参见图1(A))的实例口罩统一起来,并扩展了早期的模式语式/语义配方[24,54],以便进行全面的场景解释。
我最初的APS方法明确预测可见/渗漏/渗漏区域以捕捉孔隙-渗漏结构[37].
为了解决严重的隔离问题,我建议采用无建议层式配方,预测隔离口令不会重叠的口罩,以及一种通过基于经验的外形嵌入来完成渗透区的明度精炼剂[38]。
这改善了occided-object 分解 \\sim 5 pp,并转让给具有类似收益的模式实例分解。
由于对隐形区域的注解是主观的和昂贵的,所以我们整理了AmotoSynthDrive [43],这是一个具有模式地面真实性的大型合成数据集,并引入了一种模式深度的估测,以推断隐形几何.
我们进一步将模式推理扩展至具有模式光学流的动态[29],通过隔离来预测运动,而不是在隔离边界上失败。 这些资源后来被采用用于隔离意识适应和模式深度预训[2、3、25]。
将APS与模式流连接起来,可改进泛光跟踪,减少过境时的ID开关。

blocks.en: Forecasting. Autonomy also faces incomplete evidence in time: a robot must act before the future is observed. Building on my work on reactive panoptic tracking [ 17 ] , I introduced an end-to-end framework for vision-based semantic occupancy forecasting [ 30 ] . In contrast to two-stage pipelines that first estimate an intermediate occupancy grid and then forecasts [ 27 , 12 ] , my approach forecasts future geometry and semantics directly in the multi-view feature space. This yields a ∼ \sim 10 × \times speedup while matching or slightly improving accuracy at a 3 s horizon. The resulting representation is directly queryable by planners, supporting safer interaction in dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 预测 自主性在时间上也面临着不完整的证据:机器人必须在观察未来前行动. 根据我关于被动泛光学跟踪的工作[17],我引入了一个基于视觉的语义占用预测的端到端框架[30]. 与首先估计中间占用网格然后预测[27,12]的两阶段管道形成对比,我的方法直接在多景特征空间中预测未来的几何学和语义学. 这会产生\\ sim 10 ×\ tims 速度,同时匹配或略微提高3 s 的精度。 由此产生的表述方式可由规划人员直接查询,支持在动态环境中进行更安全的互动。

blocks.en: II-B Incomplete Knowledge: Learning Beyond the Known
blocks.zh: II-B 不完整 知识:超越已知的学习

blocks.en:
Open-world unknowns. Robots cannot rely on fixed ontologies: objects absent from training can appear at deployment. To address this holistically, I introduced panoptic out-of-distribution (OOD) segmentation [ 36 ] , augmenting panoptic parsing with an explicit unknown category (cf. Fig. 1 (B). In contrast to open-set panoptic settings that may expose unknown regions during training via void labels [ 51 , 19 ] , my formulation evaluates unknown instances that are fully held out during training. I proposed a discrepancy-driven framework that separates unknown representations from a frozen closed-world reference, improving unknown handling
while preserving in-distribution performance (mitigating a common trade-off). I extended this to 3D via an uncertainty-guided LiDAR open-set panoptic framework [ 35 ] . By deriving unknowns to emerge from evidential learning [ 44 ] and uncertainty-gated grouping, rather than feature-space clustering [ 50 ] or fixed proxies [ 5 ] , this approach yields state-of-the-art unknown segmentation quality.
blocks.zh:
开放世界未知数. 机器人不能依赖固定的本体学:没有参加训练的物体可以在部署时出现. 为了从整体上解决这一问题,我引入了泛光分解分解(OO)分解[36],用一个明确未知的类别(参见图1(B))。 与开放的设定泛光学设置相比,这些设置可能在培训期间通过空白标签暴露出未知区域[51,19],我的配方评价了培训期间完全保持的未知实例. 我提出一个差异驱动的框架,将未知的表述与冷冻的封闭世界参考区分开来,改善了未知的处理方式.
(a) 在保持分配性能的同时(减少共同的权衡)。 我通过一个不确定导导的LiDAR 开放式集成光学框架将它扩展为3D [35]. 通过从证据学习[44]和不确定因素的分组中得出未知数,而不是从特征空间分组[50]或固定代词[5]中得出未知数,这种方法产生了最先进的未知分区质量。

blocks.en:
Limited Supervision. While foundation models [ 4 , 39 ] thrive on large image corpora, comparable resources are scarce for LiDAR and hyperspectral imagery. We develop adapter-style transfer from frozen vision backbones to label-scarce modalities [ 15 , 18 ] . For LiDAR-only segmentation, we introduce a 2D-3D cross-attention adapter that injects Bird’s-Eye-View geometry into range-view features obtained from a frozen backbone. Unlike camera-LiDAR distillation methods [ 28 , 52 ] , this requires no synchronized RGB. With limited labels, it improves mIoU by +5.2/+3.0 pp over the strongest vision-distillation baselines across benchmarks [ 28 , 7 ] . For hyperspectral segmentation [ 18 ] , an adapter preserves full spectra and aligns them with frozen vision tokens, yielding up to +14.6 pp mIoU over prior works [ 46 , 14 , 49 ] . To support privacy-constrained domains, I curated a synthetic multimodal dataset [ 31 ] with dense ground truth and showed that pairing domain-specific synthetic data
with strong vision models yields accurate, domain-aligned perception with minimal real data.
blocks.zh:
有限监督. 虽然基础模型[4,39]在大型图像蝎子上蓬勃发展,但LiDAR和超光谱图像的可比资源却很少. 我们开发了适配器式的转移,从冷冻的视觉主干线到标签-稀缺模式[15,18]. 对于只使用LiDAR的分区,我们引入一个2D-3D的交叉视距适配器,将鸟眼-视距几何学注入从冷冻的骨干中获得的射程-视距特征中. 与相机-LiDAR蒸馏法[28,52]不同,这不需要同步RGB. 由于标签有限,它使mIoU在超过基准的最强的视觉-稀释基线上提高了+5.2/+3.0pp. [28, 7]. 对于超光谱分解[18],适配器保存全光谱,并与冷冻的视觉符号对齐,产生最高+14.6 pp mIoU,优于以前的作品[46,14,49]. 为了支持受隐私限制的域,我整理了一套合成的多式联运数据集[31] ,其中含有密集的地面真伪,并显示该配对域特定合成数据
拥有强大的视觉模型,产生准确的,域相匹配的感知,而真实数据却很少.

blocks.en: II-C Incomplete Reliability: Robust Multi-Modal Perception
blocks.zh: II-C 不完整 可靠性:强力多模感知

blocks.en:
I move beyond LiDAR-camera fusion pipelines that implicitly assume clean inputs toward models that explicitly reason about modality reliability. In 3D panoptic segmentation, I identify a recurring failure mode: fusing a corrupted modality can affect performance relative to using a single robust sensor(cf Fig. 1 (C)). Such corruptions arise from sensor failures and calibration drift, and can induce large drops (e.g., 5-16 pp) in PQ [ 22 ] for state-of-the-art approaches [ 41 , 53 ] . To address this, I propose a reliability-aware fusion mechanism [ 33 ] . By estimating aleatoric uncertainty via representational divergence, the model decides when to trust each modality and down-weights unreliable visual features to avoid contaminating geometric reasoning. Under ideal conditions, it remains comparable to strong fusion baseline [ 41 ] while being 6 × \times faster. More importantly, under sensor failures, sensor failures, it drops by only 1.2 pp (vs. ∼ \sim 5 pp for the IAL baseline [ 41 ] ) and remains 4.5-12.6 pp ahead under rotation-induced calibration drift [ 41 , 53 ] . Complementarily, to handle severe sensor dropout in 3D object detection, I develop a progressive fusion framework with masked cross-modal pre-training, enabling the
model to reconstruct missing features from remaining modalities [ 32 ] . Together, these contributions make multi-modal perception robust by design rather than only accurate in ideal conditions.
blocks.zh:
我超越了LiDAR-camera核聚变管道 暗含着清洁的输入 转向模式可靠性的明确理由的模型 在3D泛光学分解中,我识别出一种反复发生的故障模式:与使用单一强传感器相比,引信损坏模式会影响性能(参见图1(C))。 此类腐败产生于传感器故障和校准漂移,并可能诱发PQ[22]中的大跌(如5-16pp),用于最先进的方法[41,53]. 为了解决这个问题,我提议一种可靠意识的聚变机制[33]. 该模型通过代表差异来估计体积的不确定性,从而决定何时相信每一种模式和重量下降的不可靠的视觉特征,以避免污染几何推理。 在理想条件下,它仍然与强聚变基线[41]相当,同时速度为6××xxxx时间. 更重要的是,在传感器故障,传感器故障的情况下,IAL基线仅下降1.2页(vs. \sim 5 pp),在旋转引起的校准漂移[41,53]的情况下,仍然领先4.5-12.6页. 作为补充,为了处理3D物体探测中的严重传感器丢失问题,我开发了一个带有蒙面跨模式预训的渐进式聚变框架,从而能够
用于重建剩余模式中缺失特征的模型[32]。 这些贡献加在一起,通过设计,而不是仅仅在理想条件下准确,使多式联运观念变得强劲有力。

blocks.en: III Future Research Directions
blocks.zh: 三. 未来的研究方向

blocks.en: To advance closed-loop autonomy, the next phase of my research focuses on incompleteness-aware scene belief estimation. I plan to explore two primary themes:
blocks.zh: 为了推进闭路自主,我下一阶段的研究重点是不完全意识-场景信仰估计. 我计划探讨两个主要主题:

blocks.en: Belief-centric 4D scene representations. Instead of treating perception outputs as point estimates, I will develop methods that learn representations for jointly modeling 3D geometry, semantics, and motion alongside uncertainty (occlusion, unknowns, sensor reliability). A key direction is coupling layered amodal reasoning with semantic occupancy forecasting. As occupancy is inherently amodal, this naturally unifies object permanence and future state into a single scene belief. Evaluation will focus on calibration, robustness, and downstream planning in dynamic clutter.
blocks.zh: 以信仰为中心的4D场景表现. 我将不把感知输出作为点估计,而是制定一些方法来学习表达方式,以便联合模拟三维几何、语义和运动与不确定性(隔离、未知、传感器可靠性)。 一个关键方向是将分层模式推理与语义占用预测相结合。 由于占用本身是一种模式,这就自然地将物体的持久性和未来状态统一为一个场景信仰。 评价将侧重于动态杂乱无章的校准、稳健性和下游规划。

blocks.en: Closing the Loop: Active Sensing and Safe Adaptation. Once a robot can quantify incompleteness, it must act to resolve it behaviorally and algorithmically. First, I will study active perception policies that adapt viewpoints, sensing modalities, and motion plans to maximize expected information gain, for instance, preferring geometric sensing when visual inputs degrade. This requires uncertainty estimates that are decision, relevant and stable under shift. Algorithmically, I will explore continual learning pipelines that safely incorporate newly discovered unknowns over time. By efficiently acquiring supervision for novel object hypotheses without catastrophic forgetting, the robot will expand its open-world coverage while maintaining conservative behavior when knowledge is incomplete. Evaluation will pair controlled incompleteness suites (occlusion, corruption, novel encounters) with embodied tasks where the robot explicitly trades time and energy for uncertainty reduction.
blocks.zh: 闭环:主动感知和安全适应. 一旦机器人能够量化不完全,它就必须采取行动,从行为和算法上解决它. 首先,我将研究积极感知政策,调整观点、感知方式和运动计划,以尽量扩大预期的信息收益,例如,在视觉输入物退化时更倾向于几何感知。 这就要求作出决定的不确定性估计,这种估计具有相关性,在变化中是稳定的。 从理论上讲,我将探索不断学习的管道,以便随着时间的推移安全地纳入新发现的未知情况。 通过高效地获取对新事物假说的监督而不造成灾难性的遗忘,机器人将扩大其开放世界的覆盖范围,同时在知识不完整时保持保守行为. 评估将控制不完全套件(隔离、腐败、新颖的遭遇)与机器人明确用时间和精力换取减少不确定性的固有任务结合起来。

blocks.en: Together, these directions operationalize Perception Beyond the Visible for reliable robot autonomy.
blocks.zh: 这些方向共同操作了"视觉超越"(Perception Beyond the Visible),实现可靠的机器人自主.
